descriptionByLocale.en:
The Tschuggen Grand Hotel in Arosa is a 5-star superior luxury hotel in the Bündner Bergen located at 1'800m. As one of the four hotels in the "The Tschuggen Collection", our hotel offers 128 individually designed rooms, suites and mountain lofts, plus four stylish restaurants - including the gourmet highlight La Brezza with 19 points Gault&Millau & two Michelin stars - as well as an impressive 5 000 m2 spa mountain oasis, designed by Mario Botta. OUR VISION - We return your value to time. Are you a passionate and empathetic host, appreciative & respectful? Then you are right with us. After more than 4 years, our current job holder leaves us to face a new challenge. For this reason, we are looking for permanent employment on 1 October 2026 or by agreement (at the latest in mid-November).
• Professional and operational management of a housekeeping team with up to 40 employees during the summer and winter season
• Overall responsibility for cleanliness, care and value preservation of guest rooms, suites, public areas, sanitary facilities, lingerie and employee accommodation
• Creation of efficient and demand-oriented service and deployment planning taking into account occupancy, budget and quality requirements
• Ensuring and continuously developing the quality standards of the hotel as well as the LQA and Leading Hotels of the World Standards
• Responsibility for inventory and material management including purchasing, ordering, incoming goods inspection and economic use of cleaning products, laundry, guest supplies and equipment
• Professional onboarding as well as continuous training, training and promotion of employees
• Implementation of regular quality controls and initiation and follow-up of optimisation measures
• Working closely with Front Office, Technology, Laundry and F&B to ensure smooth hotel operations
• Responsibility for all administrative tasks in housekeeping, including inventories, key figures, monthly accounts, budget control and reporting
• Active participation and optimization of processes as well as ensuring efficient workflows |
• Several years of professional experience in a comparable management position, ideally in the seasonal and luxury hotel industry
• Professional experience in a 5-star or 5-star superior hotel; Knowledge of LQA standards or comparable international quality standards is an advantage
• Very good knowledge of German and fluent English in words and writing; Other foreign languages are welcome
• Strong leadership and social skills as well as the ability to motivate, promote and develop employees
• High service orientation, discretion and a sovereign, professional appearance
• Organization-strong, structured and solution-oriented personality with the ability to maintain an overview even in demanding situations
• Responsible, reliable and flexible working methods with a strong hands-on mentality
• High quality awareness and a keen eye for detail and perfection
• Empathetic, communicative and team-oriented personality with excellent manners
• Well-maintained appearance as well as a stylish and representative appearance according to the upscale hotel industry | Attractive staff accommodation near the hotel Balanced menu offer in our stafftrattoria with vegetarian & vegan options 24/7 Use of our fitness center Local advantages such as special prices at sports shops, ski passes and much more special prices for overnight stays in our hotels of "The Tschuggen Collection" and the Swiss Deluxe Hotels | Feel addressed - Apply now! We look forward to your application dossier - gladly digital: Application letter Full CV incl. Photo Certificates & Diplomas | Ennio Loffreda Tschuggentorweg 1 7050 Arosa

• Formation et promotion professionnelles des salariés
• Mise en œuvre de contrôles réguliers de qualité et lancement et suivi de mesures d'optimisation
• Collaborer étroitement avec le Front Office, la Technologie, la Blanchisserie et les F&B pour assurer des opérations hôtelières harmonieuses
• Responsabilité de toutes les tâches administratives en matière d'entretien ménager, y compris les inventaires, les chiffres clés, les comptes mensuels, le contrôle budgétaire et l'établissement de rapports

• Expérience professionnelle dans un hôtel 5 étoiles ou 5 étoiles supérieur; Connaissance des normes LQA ou des normes de qualité internationales comparables est un avantage
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais couramment dans les mots et l'écriture; D'autres langues étrangères sont les bienvenues
